description: This file defines the InsightsRoutingBaseService class, which provides methods for retrieving and processing routing and form response data, including funnel data, table data, statistics, and CSV export functionalities. It interacts with a Prisma database and utilizes various utility functions and external repositories.

classes.name: InsightsRoutingBaseService
classes.description: Provides methods to fetch and process insights routing data, including funnel analysis, table data, statistics, and CSV export, with support for authorization and filtering.

methods.name: getRoutingFunnelData
methods.description: Retrieves routing funnel data split by specified date ranges, including total submissions, successful routings, and accepted bookings.

methods.name: getTableData
methods.description: Fetches paginated routing form response data with sorting, including detailed response info, attendees, and fields.

methods.name: getRoutingFormStats
methods.description: Calculates total responses, responses without bookings, and booking ratios, with optional filtering by booking UID.

methods.name: buildOrderByClause
methods.description: Constructs SQL ORDER BY clause based on provided sorting options, with default fallback.

methods.name: getRoutedToPerPeriodData
methods.description: Provides routed-to data per day/week/month with pagination, including user performance indicators.

methods.name: getRoutedToPerPeriodCsvData
methods.description: Exports routed-to per period data in CSV format, aggregating responses per user and period.

methods.name: getBaseConditions
methods.description: Builds combined authorization and filter conditions for queries.

methods.name: getFilterConditions
methods.description: Generates SQL conditions based on column filters and date range filters.

methods.name: getAuthorizationConditions
methods.description: Creates SQL conditions for data access based on user scope and permissions.

methods.name: buildOrgAuthorizationCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition for organization scope, including all associated teams.

methods.name: buildTeamAuthorizationCondition
methods.description: Builds SQL condition for team scope, verifying team and organization hierarchy.

methods.name: isOwnerOrAdmin
methods.description: Checks if a user has owner or admin permissions for a team.

methods.name: buildFormFieldSqlCondition
methods.description: Creates SQL condition for filtering form response fields based on filter value.

methods.name: buildAttendeeSqlCondition
methods.description: Creates SQL condition for filtering attendee data based on filter value.

methods.name: getFailedBookingsByFieldData
methods.description: Retrieves data on failed bookings grouped by form, field, and option, including response counts.
